A town in an unknown nation. Mat tried to convince Talmanes to help him win a pair of barmaids there.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Sabinel}}

The town has a single reference during [[Tarmon Gai'don]]. A Seanchan messenger sent to [[Mat]] from Talmanes tells him that the Dragons are out of commission and that they had as much luck as the barmaids in Sabinel. When asked to explain, Mat tells the messenger that the maids there work for tips, but the people of the town never tip. In reality, Mat had a hard time flirting with the barmaids there and Talmanes suggested faking an old war wound for sympathy. The message is a code that the Dragons are not as damaged as the messenge would otherwise indicate.{{ref/book|14|37}}
